svg.aria-label: Seated cable row, Reach: Sit with knees slightly bent and reach for the handle without rounding your lower back.
svg.title: Seated cable row, Reach: Sit with knees slightly bent and reach for the handle without rounding your lower back.

svg.aria-label: Seated cable row, Row: Drive your elbows back with your chest tall.
svg.title: Seated cable row, Row: Drive your elbows back with your chest tall.

svg.aria-label: Seated cable row, Finish: Pull the handle to your navel and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

svg.aria-label: Seated cable row, Return: Reach forward under control while keeping your lower back steady.
